details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (overall financial performance), K2 (revenue breakdown), K3 (installment loans in Europe), K4 (smartphone financing in Kenya and Uganda), K6 (AI voice agents pilot), K8 (bond refinancing and issuance), K9 (dividend distribution), and K10 (impairment expense). However, it omits the core material meaning of K5 (expansion into Tanzania), K7 (EUR 40 million bond tap in March 2025), K11 (regulatory challenge in Moldova), and K12 (post-reporting period funding). While several HIGH importance items are missing, the main picture of the financial performance and key strategic initiatives is captured, justifying a 'Generally yes' score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected without contradictions. Growth drivers (flexible vehicle financing, consumer lending) are clearly identified and contrasted with the decline in traditional vehicle financing [S3-S5]. Financial performance metrics (revenue, net loan portfolio, EBITDA) are presented consistently [S1-S2]. The explanation for stable net profit despite operational improvements (foreign exchange losses) is logically sound [S7]. Capital structure changes are clearly explained with corresponding ratios [S10-S11]. Geographic and product diversification are presented as strategic strengths [S4, S13]. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the summary forms a clear narrative from performance highlights to strategic initiatives.
